title: [BUG] $ref cannot have keywords {'description'}.
body:
### Required prerequisites

- [x] I have read the documentation <https://camel-ai.github.io/camel/camel.html>.
- [x] I have searched the [Issue Tracker](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/issues) and [Discussions](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions) that this hasn't already been reported. (+1 or comment there if it has.)
- [x] Consider asking first in a [Discussion](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/discussions/new).

### What version of camel are you using?

0.2.74

### System information

3.10.12 (main, May 27 2025, 17:12:29) [GCC 11.4.0] linux
0.2.74

### Problem description
When some argument in tool schema contains $ref, the description field will trigger an error when call the OpenAI models.

```python
model = ModelFactory.create(
    model_platform=ModelPlatformType.AZURE,
    model_type=ModelType.GPT_4O,
    model_config_dict=ChatGPTConfig(temperature=0.2).as_dict(),
    api_version="2024-12-01-preview",
    api_key=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    url=os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    azure_deployment_name="gpt-4o",
)
agent = ChatAgent(
    system_message="You are a helpful assistant. When I say Bye, you should say Goodbye and terminate the conversation.",
    model=model,
    tools=[FunctionTool(save_user_info)],
    response_terminators=[terminators.ResponseWordsTerminator(words_dict={"bye": 1})],
)
```

Tool Function:
```python
def save_user_info(user: User):
    """
    Save user input to a file.
    Args:
        user: User
    Returns:
        User
    """
    return user
```

Generated Tool Schema:
```yaml
- function:
    description: Save user input to a file.
    name: save_user_info
    parameters:
      $defs:
        User:
          additionalProperties: false
          properties:
            age:
              type: integer
            email:
              type: string
            name:
              type: string
          required:
          - name
          - age
          - email
          type: object
      additionalProperties: false
      properties:
        user:
          $ref: '#/$defs/User'
          description: User
      required:
      - user
      type: object
    strict: true
  type: function
```

Error: 
```
camel.models.model_manager.ModelProcessingError: Unable to process messages: the only provided model did not run successfully. Error: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': "Invalid schema for function 'save_user_info': context=('properties', 'user'), $ref cannot have keywords {'description'}.", 'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'param': 'tools[0].function.parameters', 'code': 'invalid_function_parameters'}}
```

### Additional context

https://github.com/OAI/OpenAPI-Specification/issues/1514

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.

This is an agent issue because it involves tool invocation and schema generation for an agent system using OpenAI models. The error arises from how the agent's tool schema is constructed and passed to the LLM provider, matching "Tool implementation errors" and "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers".
